newtripoli.name: New Tripoli Simulation Terminal
newtripoli.description: Deterministic, hash-verifiable science instruments for the New Tripoli scenario — relativistic delivery, time-dilation, digital-mind feasibility (Landauer vs Sahara cap), and a graded D1–D10 claim ledger. 13 client-side, zero-egress calculators; each emits an OpenChainGraph-conformant artifact carrying a verifiable SHA-256 execution_hash.
